title: Skill front matter
description: The YAML block between the leading '---' lines of a SKILL.md, as src/rh/kernel/skills.py parses it (yaml.safe_load; a non-mapping is treated as empty). The kernel reads role (default 'producer'), scaffold_marker (default '<!-- scaffold -->'), and description, and hashes the whole file as the Skill's identity. tests/conformance/test_skill_library.py checks reads/outputs (producer) and gate/outputs/context (prover) against every Loop kind that names the Skill.

output_name.description: a file name (brief.md) or a directory name ending in / (sources/), exactly as the kind's consumes/produces spell it

description.description: one sentence: from which inputs it writes which output, for which step of which kind

reads.description: superset of every naming step's consumes, minus goal.md and success_spec.yaml

outputs.description: superset of every naming step's produces

scaffold_marker.description: the token the scaffold-absent gate looks for in this Skill's outputs; the kernel uses the default when omitted

description.description: one sentence: what it verifies, against which ground, for which gate

id.description: the gate id in the kind's gates.agent[] entry

ground.description: must equal the kind's declaration; human ground is a Decision, never a prover

serves.description: criterion kinds, a superset of the kind's serves (supported, answers, coverage, novelty, argument, ...)

routing.description: how faults.route sends a finding: to the checked step, or to an upstream step named in implicates that produced a cited hash
